# An iron brazier (generated by make_env.py): a plinth, a column, a bowl, glowing coals (unlit) and the
# stippled pool of light on the floor (textures/halo.png, alpha-masked, unlit). Origin on the floor.
new
material new Iron --base-color 0.1490 0.1255 0.1137 --no-slot
material new Trim --base-color 0.3216 0.3255 0.2980 --no-slot
material new Coal --base-color 0.6627 0.1922 0.1882 --no-slot
material new Pool --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture Pool base-color textures/halo.png
material set Pool alpha-mode mask
material set Pool alpha-cutoff 0.5
add mesh cylinder --name Base --vertices 8 --radius 0.360 --depth 0.160 --location 0.000 0.000 0.080
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
material assign Trim
active Base
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name Post --vertices 8 --radius 0.130 --depth 0.760 --location 0.000 0.000 0.540
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
material assign Iron
active Post
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cone --name Bowl --vertices 8 --radius1 0.220 --radius2 0.500 --depth 0.300 --location 0.000 0.000 1.050
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
material assign Iron
active Bowl
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cone --name Coals --vertices 8 --radius1 0.470 --radius2 0.360 --depth 0.100 --location 0.000 0.000 1.170
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
material assign Coal
active Coals
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
add mesh circle --name Pool --vertices 16 --radius 2.4 --cap-fill ngon --location 0.000 0.000 0.030
material assign Pool
active Pool
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
select all
shade flat
export brazier.glb
